chunks: He said: Abu Nasr Muhammad ibn al-Husayn al-Muqri reported to me, saying: Abu Abdillah al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Bazzaz narrated to us, saying: Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Abdillah al-Alawi al-Muhammadi narrated to us, saying: Yahya ibn Hashim al-Ghassani narrated to us, from Ma'mar ibn Sulaiman, from Laith ibn Abi Sulaim, from Ata ibn Abi Rabah, from Ibn Abbas who said:

The Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his family, said: "O people, cling steadfastly to the love of us, the Ahl al-Bayt, for whoever meets God with love for us shall enter Paradise through our intercession. By He Who holds the soul of Muhammad in His hand, the deeds of a servant shall not benefit him except with recognition of us and our wilayah."

key_terms.شفاعة: Shafa'ah — intercession on the Day of Judgment.
key_terms.معرفة: Ma'rifah — recognition, knowledge of the Imams' station and authority.
key_terms.مودة: Mawaddah — love, affection, cordial attachment. In Quran 42:23, God commands love for the Prophet's near kin.
key_terms.ولاية: Wilayah — guardianship, authority. A central concept in Shia theology regarding the authority of the Imams.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the importance of loving Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addressed the people, commanding them to hold firmly to love for his household (Ahl al-Bayt). He declared that love for Ahl al-Bayt leads to Paradise through their intercession, and swore an oath that no person's deeds would avail them without recognizing the Ahl al-Bayt and accepting their wilayah (authority/guardianship). This hadith was reportedly delivered as a public address, emphasizing that good deeds alone are insufficient without devotion to the Prophet's family.
